name: NEXEREN Civrieux datacenters
notes: NEXEREN says it operates interconnected datacenters from Civrieux (01) to Montpellier; DCmag and PeeringDB place the facility at Technoparc Saone Vallee, Civrieux, Ain.

name: MAXNOD Datacenter
notes: Operator site lists a certified datacenter at 1411 route de Sandrans, Saint-Trivier-sur-Moignans. DCD and Le Monde Informatique reported severe fire damage on 2023-03-28, so current operating status is treated as unknown.

name: Ikoula IKDC02
notes: DCmag lists IKDC02 in Aisne with 450 m2 IT surface; Usine Digitale reported Ikoula opening a second data center in an Aisne village after acquiring a former bank disaster-recovery site.

name: Departement des Alpes-de-Haute-Provence secure territorial data center containers
notes: Public tender describes supply, delivery, implementation, and operation of two container data centers at college Camille Reymond in Chateau-Arnoux-Saint-Auban and the gendarmerie heliport station in Aiglun.

name: UltraEdge Entrepierres
notes: Datacenters.com lists UltraEdge Entrepierres as a data center in Alpes-de-Haute-Provence; no public capacity found.

name: UltraEdge Le Lauzet-Ubaye
notes: Datacenters.com lists one UltraEdge data center in Le Lauzet-Ubaye and two UltraEdge facilities in Alpes-de-Haute-Provence overall; no public capacity found.

name: nLighten Antibes / Sophia Antipolis I NCE1
notes: nLighten's Antibes edge data center page states 1,500 m2 dedicated colocation space and 6,000 kW of power in northern Antibes near Nice airport.

name: nLighten Valbonne / Sophia Antipolis II NCE2
notes: nLighten's Valbonne edge data center page states 700 m2 dedicated colocation space and 6,000 kW of power; third-party listings associate it with NCE2 in Alpes-Maritimes.

name: Titan Datacenter DC1 Mougins
notes: DCmag described Titan DC1 in Mougins as a 4,200 m2 project with 24,000 kW useful power; DCmag's directory lists the current DC1 location in Alpes-Maritimes.

name: Evroc Mougins AI factory
notes: DCD reported Evroc plans a phased 96 MW hyperscale AI data center in Mougins, north of Cannes, with the first phase due live in 2025.

name: Azur Datacenter AZ02 Sophia Antipolis
notes: DCmag directory places AZ02 at 950 Route des Colles, Sophia Antipolis, Biot, Alpes-Maritimes; capacity not found in public sources.

name: Flexicore DC2-PRI Privas
notes: Flexicore states it operates two Auvergne-Rhone-Alpes data centers, including DC2-PRI in Privas, Ardeche, with five racks in production, redundant power, generator, and multi-operator fiber.

name: Adista / former Equadex Pamiers data center
notes: La Depeche reported the Pamiers data center entered service in 2021 after a two-year build. Inherent/Keensight and DCD later identified Equadex's Pamiers and Labege data centers as part of the Inherent/Adista network; Adista references a Pamiers HDS data center in 2026.

name: Conseil Departemental de l'Ariege Foix data center
notes: Public works tender 2026EB822 covers construction of a data center in Foix, with lots for civil works, structural/foundations, modular buildings, HVAC/plumbing, and electrical works; listed market duration is 20 months.

name: PanaFrance Aéromia Romilly-sur-Seine data center
notes: DCmag reported PanaFrance announced a 200,000 m2 data center component on 39 ha at the Aeromia zone in Romilly-sur-Seine, Aube, integrated into a larger economic redevelopment project.

name: EXA Narbonne / Saint-Marcel-sur-Aude data center
notes: Datacenters.com and DCmag directory list EXA Infrastructure's Narbonne data center at La Garrigue / Zone d'Activite La Garrigue, Saint-Marcel-sur-Aude, Aude.

name: AtaCenter Carcassonne
notes: ColoMap lists AtaCenter as a colocation data center operated by Ataraxie at 80 Allee d'Iena, Carcassonne, Aude. Occitanie CCI notes data centers in Occitanie include sites in Carcassonne.
